engine.notes: All 14 archive entries were re-verified by direct fetch and all 14 are retained; none is evidenced as closed. One new entry added: Cornservatory (Corn Productions), a live Lincoln Square storefront theatre, verified directly but scored conservatively pending confirmation of its class and show schedule. CIC Theater has relocated to a new North Side space and is mid-fundraise for the build-out; Home

entries.name: The Second City
entries.summary: The flagship Chicago improv and sketch institution, running mainstage shows nightly and a full class pipeline from Improv Level 1 through the Conservatory.
entries.schedule: Rolling class terms, next cohort starts late Oct 2026; auditions Oct 8, 2026.
signals: Improv Levels 1-5 plus a 3-level Conservatory and Grad Revue
Classes start on rolling multi-week terms rather than single annual cohorts
History & Alumni archive referencing Del Close improv lineage
Live Oct 2026 enrollment and audition dates confirmed on-site
entries.reasons: The best-known improv institution in the world, with its own venue, a complete beginner-to-performer class ladder, and a live, current enrollment page.

entries.name: iO Theater
entries.summary: Historic Chicago improv theater running shows six nights a week across improv, sketch and stand-up, alongside classes for all levels and youth programs.
entries.schedule: Shows six nights a week; iO Fest 2026 upcoming.
signals: Operating continuously since 1981
House teams and six nights of weekly programming
Teen & Youth classes plus an iO Summer Intensive
iO Fest 2026 listed as an active upcoming event
entries.reasons: A historic, continuously-running theater with its own venue, nightly shows and a broad class program, though its class levels and terms are less itemized on-site than Second City's.

entries.name: The Annoyance Theatre & Bar
entries.summary: Long-running Lakeview improv and sketch theater under Mick Napier, staging original shows seven nights a week alongside its own training program.
entries.schedule: Shows seven nights a week; live Oct 2, 2026 listings confirmed.
signals: Operating for over 35 years
Shows seven nights a week
Training based on Mick Napier's 'Improvise: Scene From the Inside Out'
Homepage showed live, dated Oct 2, 2026 show listings at time of check
entries.reasons: A decades-old theater with its own venue and a packed, verifiably current show calendar; classes are real but less itemized on-site than the largest schools.

entries.name: Piven Theatre Workshop
entries.summary: Evanston theatre training institution built on improv-based technique, running youth and adult classes, summer camps and a current public production.
entries.schedule: Current production running now ('The Cookie Jar'); classes run year-round.
signals: Operating for over 50 years
Youth, adult and corporate class tracks plus summer camps
Current mainstage production ticketed and running now
Notable-alumni section and an actively maintained 2026-dated site
entries.reasons: A genuinely venerable, improv-rooted institution with its own venue, broad classes and a show running right now.

entries.name: Logan Square Improv
entries.summary: Nonprofit storefront improv theater in Logan Square with a three-level class program and $5 improv shows running Wednesday through Sunday.
signals: 501(c)(3) nonprofit improv theater
Three-level improv class program
Shows Wednesday-Sunday at $5 a ticket, BYOB
Corporate workshops offered alongside public programming
entries.reasons: A real neighborhood theater with its own venue, a defined if short class ladder, and a near-weekly show calendar.

entries.name: CIC Theater
entries.area: North Side, Chicago (new location on N Western Ave)
entries.summary: Nonprofit storefront improv theater that has just relocated to a new North Side home, running free weekly shows and an email-enrollment class program.
entries.schedule: Tue 7pm, Wed 8pm, Thu 7pm & 9pm, Fri 9:30pm — free shows.
signals: 501(c)(3) nonprofit improv theater
Site states 'we are now in our new space'; actively fundraising for the build-out
Multiple free shows Tuesday through Friday
Active Instagram presence for schedule and class updates
entries.reasons: A solid weekly show calendar and nonprofit standing, but the mid-relocation status and email-only class signup hold back the longevity and class-program scores.

entries.name: The Comedy Clubhouse
entries.summary: Wicker Park comedy venue operating since 2015, running a 'Laughter School' improv program for young adults alongside workshops and ticketed shows.
entries.schedule: Shows booked via an external ticketing link; see site for class enrollment.
signals: Operating since 2015
Laughter School improv instruction plus an audition pathway for performers
Has its own Wicker Park venue
Show booking routes to an external ticketing platform rather than an on-site calendar
entries.reasons: A decade-old venue with real programming, held back by routing its live show calendar through a third-party ticket link rather than its own site.

entries.name: Improvised Shakespeare Company
entries.summary: Fully-improvised Shakespeare-style plays performed as a standing Friday/Saturday resident show at iO Theater, Chicago, alongside a national tour.
signals: Confirmed recurring Fri/Sat 7:30pm Chicago show at iO Theater
Active national tour dates through early 2027
No class program found on the site
Site footer copyright reads 2020, though the show schedule itself is current
entries.reasons: A genuinely current, well-attended recurring show with no home venue or class program of its own, which caps it below the full theaters.

entries.name: Baby Wants Candy
entries.summary: Chicago-founded fully-improvised musical comedy show that tours Chicago, New York, LA and Edinburgh, with workshops offered alongside performances.
entries.schedule: Varies by city; current dates linked from the site.
signals: Chicago-founded touring improvised-musical format
Active listings across four cities including the Edinburgh Fringe
Workshops referenced in site navigation
Live show dates point off-site to a linked schedule page rather than the main site
entries.reasons: A well-known, long-running format with strong critical praise, but it tours rather than anchoring a Chicago home venue and keeps its live schedule off its own site.

entries.name: The Revival
entries.summary: Chicago improv training organization offering adult classes, school programs and corporate workshops; its public-shows page is currently unavailable.
entries.schedule: See site for class enrollment; no public show calendar found.
signals: Site copy ties the organization to Chicago's improv history
Adult, school and professional/corporate program tracks
Testimonials from Harris Associates and the Booth School of Business
The /shows page returns an HTTP 404, suggesting no current public show calendar
entries.reasons: A credible, established training and corporate-improv provider, but without a confirmed public show calendar it scores low on the shows component.

entries.name: Oak Park Improv
entries.summary: Community improv program in Oak Park running an 8-week beginner-friendly adult class through the Park District plus occasional free Open Stage nights.
signals: Current Park District of Oak Park session runs through Nov 2026
8-week, beginner-friendly class format
Free Open Stage night hosted at the Oak Park Public Library
Community-organized rather than a dedicated venue of its own
entries.reasons: A real, currently-enrolling community class with no venue of its own and only an occasional open-stage night rather than a weekly show.

entries.name: Cornservatory
entries.summary: A Lincoln Square storefront theatre run by the nonprofit Corn Productions, staging its own original comedy and improv-rooted productions.
entries.schedule: Current productions listed on-site; a specific recurring weekly night was not confirmed.
signals: Run by Corn Productions, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit
Own storefront venue at 4210 N Lincoln Ave
Current season listed on-site (productions running now)
entries.reasons: A real, live nonprofit theatre with its own venue and an active season, scored conservatively because a class program and a dated weekly show calendar could not be confirmed directly.

entries.name: The Home Comedy Theater
entries.summary: New Lakeview improv venue from veteran Chicago instructors, already running real 8-week class sessions while its public show calendar is still 'coming soon.'
entries.schedule: Classes meet weekly for 3 hours across 8-week sessions; show schedule not yet live.
signals: Instructors described as decades-experienced Chicago improv teachers
Real 8-week, multi-level class structure with active registration
Homepage shows/events section reads 'coming soon'
Site copyright dated 2026
entries.reasons: Real, structured classes are already running, but with no operating history and no live shows yet it can't score well on longevity or the shows component.

entries.name: Comedy Plex
entries.summary: Oak Park comedy training center offering improv classes for kids, teens and adults, though its online show and class schedule blocks are currently broken.
entries.schedule: Unclear — schedule blocks on-site are not rendering.
signals: Serves kids, teens and adults per site copy
Dedicated Training Center and Classes navigation
Multiple schedule sections show raw 'Dynamic Snippet' placeholder errors instead of content
Hosts its own events such as the Funny Is Female Comedy Festival
entries.reasons: The organization and venue appear real and active, but a broken, unmaintained schedule on its own site undercuts both the class-program and currency scores.

entries.name: The Playground Theater
entries.summary: Long-running Uptown improv theatre at 4416 N Clark St. Its website has collapsed to a one-line address stub, so no current show or class listing could be confirmed this cycle.
signals: Homepage reduced to one line: 'The Playground Theater • 4416 N Clark St • UPSTAIRS & Online'
/shows, /classes and /calendar all return HTTP 404
No closure announcement anywhere on the site
Address and "UPSTAIRS & Online" still published, which reads as ongoing operation
entries.reasons: Scored very low because nothing beyond the address could be verified — no readable calendar, house teams or class pathway — but a broken website is not evidence of closure, so it is kept as a listing pending a human check.
